description.p: Debian CachyOS Kernel Updater is a native GTK4 and Libadwaita utility that automates the discovery, compilation, installation, and verification of high-performance CachyOS kernels on Debian-based systems.

Through a guided three-step workflow, users can upgrade to performance-tuned kernels with BORE scheduler optimizations, automatic DKMS rebuilds, fallback kernel retention, and cryptographic MOK Secure Boot signing.

ul.li: Automated Kernel Discovery: Queries upstream CachyOS releases and matches optimal CPU microarchitectures (x86-64-v3 and v4)
Guided 1-2-3 Workflow: Step-by-step verification, pre-installation checks, and automated GRUB configuration
Secure Boot Integration: Automatic Machine Owner Key (MOK) signing for proprietary modules (NVIDIA, Wi-Fi, VirtualBox)
Fallback & Rollback Protection: Retains proven stable kernels to guarantee a bootable system
Containerized Build Isolation: Compiles and packages deb images inside isolated container environments
